My co-worker has asked me to come in for him a couple of times before and I came in for him on one occasion. I asked him to cover one of my shifts later on so the way I see it we're even on owing favors. He messages me right after I decline with "Of course not" (his exact words) Made me feel like an asshole so here I am. Am I the asshole?
